title: October 5, 2026 physical scanner MRD protocol audit

method.mrd_header: Embedded PPR text begins at the first :PPL record; dimensions and datatype are read from the MRD binary header, following scanner/recon/get_mrd_3d4.py conventions.
method.comparison: Each embedded PPR is compared with the adjacent PPR; JSON sidecars are checked against embedded PE order, diffusion flag, delta timings, b-values, and slice spacing when available.
method.acquisition_time: AcquisitionStartTime is reported as the embedded hardware performance-counter tick value with its frequency; it is not treated as a calendar timestamp.
method.file_time: MRD filesystem modification timestamps are reported in UTC and are not treated as acquisition times.
method.payload_check: Expected complex payload bytes are calculated from MRD dimensions and datatype; the embedded PPR must follow the payload with at least the reader's 120-byte interstitial region.
method.source_provenance: Git history audit at HEAD 724b9a7 found tracked scanner PPL releases 1.6 and 1.7, no tracked or historical 1.8 PPL/PPR source. MRDs identify their acquisition source by the embedded scanner path ending in twoTE-1.8.ppl; exact v1.8 source provenance cannot be verified from this repository.
